entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single photographic rehab assessment step 040_E-AXU-007_s02. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the frontal seated neutral baseline. Keep exactly the same woman, face, ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal pants, BARE feet, gray upholstered stationary armless chair, silver legs, soft light, gray-blue seamless background, camera position, focal length, framing, scale and 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Change ONLY the upper-body posture from neutral to a gentle SEATED LATERAL SIDE-BEND toward the woman's own LEFT, which is the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE. Her upper trunk and head shift and tilt about 15 degrees toward image right with left shoulder (image right shoulder) lowering, and her own LEFT relaxed arm and hand slide naturally lower downward along the outside edge of the chair on IMAGE RIGHT. Her own right arm, image left, hangs relaxed and becomes slightly higher. It must look like a modest comfortable lateral curve through upper trunk, not a rigid entire body lean or just neck tilt. Both buttocks and both sitting bones stay firmly on the level chair seat, pelvis level and centered exactly where it is; no lifting either hip. The chair, hips, both thighs, forward-facing knees, lower legs, both bare feet and their exact floor contacts stay unchanged from input. No chest, pelvis, head or chair rotation: she remains facing camera. No forward bend, back arch, one hip raise, arms raised, crossing legs, changing chair, cropped body, text, arrows or collage. Preserve complete head, hands, feet and seat contact regions. Output ONE photograph only.

attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one standalone rehabilitation assessment demonstration photograph, 040_E-AXU-007_s01, neutral seated starting position. Input images 1,2,3 are reference images only for the EXACT same adult Chinese woman, facial identity, age, skin, body proportions, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal dark gray long pants, photography and gray-blue background. Generate ONE single full-body photograph, portrait format (prefer 1024 x 1536), no collage. Scene: seamless gray-blue studio backdrop and floor, soft studio light and natural grounding shadows. Camera: direct straight-on frontal view, camera level near abdomen, natural portrait lens without perspective distortion; she and chair face directly forward, centered with generous border, complete head, both hands, both bare feet, all support contacts and chair legs inside frame. Pose: the woman sits upright neutrally and steadily near the front of a stable stationary armless chair with a simple gray padded seat and slender metal frame, no wheels, no swivel. Both sitting bones and both sides of buttocks remain firmly contacting the level seat. Hips and knees around 90 degrees; thighs level; knees pointing forward, feet hip width, both soles and heels flat on the floor, relaxed toes. Both arms hang naturally alongside the sides of the chair, elbows nearly straight and fingers relaxed, each hand visible below seat-edge level; hands neither grip nor rest atop seat. Chest and pelvis face the camera, shoulders level, spine neutral, head balanced upright, eyes forward. Keep natural reference body proportions. No leaning, bending, twisting, slouching, shrugging, raised arms, crossed arms, new objects, text, numbers, arrows, watermark, anatomical overlays. The chair seat remains visible at both sides of hips so the buttock-seat contacts are understandable.
